Boss: Headless Rider eaMN5CfciNlxfezSKemJ6 (push/263 rules), one objective open_raid at sector 999, the river sector where the quest ends (players must stand in the sector to join; raids do not enforce prerequisiteQuestId, so the prerequisite documents intent only). data.name: The Headless Rider
data.description: The Headless Rider rides again along the river where his skull was lost. Gather your squad and break his charge.
data.successDescription: The Headless Rider has been driven back into the mist.

objectives.description: Moonlight on black water. The laugh comes first, then the hooves. The Headless Rider has returned to the river, scythe in hand, and every shinobi who answers the call strikes at the same cursed rider.
objectives.successDescription: The rider's scythe falls into the river and his laugh breaks apart on the wind.
objectives.failDescription: You failed to defeat the raid boss
objectives.fleeDescription: You fled from the raid boss
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ended in a draw
